blocks.text: Rainleaf preserves a small act of keeping something gentle for later. A caretaker need not know a long account of the weather to recognize a leaf holding a drop; learning what that drop does remains part of care.
A folded plum-colored leaf envelope with silver veins enclosing a pearly droplet.
One-shot use: The leaf tilts sharply and pours a large silver stream until its stored drop is gone. The game performs the final fade.
13 silver. Stress severity −1; reaching zero clears the condition. Happiness +10. Recovery timers become 75% of their remaining time; Potion Boost gives +1 to skills for 5 minutes.
Original PixelLab artwork and reviewed use animation, October 28, 2026. Image 6b725ea5-6188-4bf8-85de-2c3383d82491; animation de6b2fe3-48e3-42a2-ab12-32b2ddc621d8. Reduced motion holds a still.
